ns2:course.label: Graduate Theory Review
ns2:course.description: Review of concepts from undergraduate music theory, including materials from the common practice period (50xA) and the twentieth century (50xB). Concepts studied include compositional materials and basic form and analysis. 3 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated. Credit is not given towards graduate degrees. Prerequisite: Restricted to graduate standing in music.
